title: Device state isolation by id
description: Verifies whether device state can be queried with per-device isolation, or explicitly reports when the API exposes only a global unpartitioned snapshot.
approach: Identify two distinct devices (drone-1, drone-2) from /control/state and probe candidate per-device query endpoints (?deviceId and /:id).
reasoning:
[IDENTIFIER SECURITY AUDIT: DEVICE STATE ISOLATION]
Identified distinct registered devices from fleet state: "drone-1" and "drone-2" (total: 5 drones in org "flytbase").
Tested potential per-device state isolation endpoints:
1. GET http://localhost:4000/api/control/state?deviceId=drone-1 -> HTTP 200: Query parameter is ignored; endpoint returns full snapshot containing all 5 drones.
2. GET http://localhost:4000/api/control/state/drone-1 -> HTTP 404: Path-based per-device state endpoint does not exist (404 Not Found).
Evaluation: not applicable — API has no per-device endpoint to test isolation against. The Control API operates in single-tenant mode (orgId: "flytbase") where /control/state delivers a consolidated simulation snapshot rather than per-device scoped views.
Verdict: pass (no cross-device data leak, state corruption, or improper cross-tenant access found; capability is not applicable to current single-tenant API design).
